source.text:
如果都是 $100 的订阅最多可以使用多少额度

- Claude Max：4640🔪的Opus 5.5或 2730🔪的Fable 5.2
 
- Google AI Ultra：2580🔪 的 Gemini 4 Neon

- ChatGPT Pro：1025 🔪的 GPT-6.1 Sol

总体来说还是Claude的额度更多，GPT的最少，Gemini中规中矩，根据模型的单价和缓存也有关系……

primaryMeasurementSource.noteTweet:
Just measured how much more AI usage you get from a subscription. $100 of Claude Max buys about $4,640 of Opus at API prices.

The results:
- Claude Max ($100): 46.4x on Opus 5.5, 27.3x on Fable 5.2
- Google AI Ultra ($99.99): 25.8x on Gemini 4 Neon
- X Premium ($30): 20.3x on Grok 4.7
- ChatGPT Pro ($100): 10.25x (measured in October)
- Muse Code High Usage ($15): 9.3x (October)

How this affects the Bug Hunt Benchmark: 🧵

distinctFrom.why: 同作者 11-10 的 Claude Ultra $200 API 价值图（Opus 5.5 only $14,662；Fable 5.2 only $3,021；一个月按 30 天=4.3 个周限）。套餐是 Ultra $200 不是 Max $100，测量声称是 Aug 11–Nov 9 的 1.1M proxied requests，不是本图 Nov 19–20 的 plan meter。风格相近，但不能把 $14,662/200 折成 $100 去对 $4,640，也不能当本条的补强更新。
Carbon Vertex 价目卡，不是用量或订阅倍率。
另一作者口述 Fable 订阅额外消耗约 2.3–2.5 倍。不是本图，不要和 27.3x / 13.6x 混算。

screenshotChart.title: How much more AI usage does a subscription buy than the API?
screenshotChart.subtitle: A month of each plan's allowance, priced at the vendor's public API rates, divided by the plan's price. 46.4x means $100 a month buys what $4,640 buys on the API.
screenshotChart.footer: Black whiskers: the measured range. Measured Nov 19-20, 2026 (ChatGPT Pro, Muse: Oct 1) on each plan's own meter, at public API list rates. Assumes the whole week is usable. Claude Max's $100 of monthly API credits not counted.
screenshotChart.monthConventionOnChart: A month of each plan's allowance; assumes the whole week is usable. Does not state repo monthWeeks=4 vs 30/7.

rows.note: ≈ $1,360 of Fable a month. Fable may use only half the week: 13.6× on Fable alone. 27.3× is the full bar, not Fable-only (27.3×100=2730). Hatched remainder is visible on the bar.

pawelMethodReplies.text: I just burned through a few % of my weekly usage and observed every 1% tick. Default settings. In Claude, you can type /autocompact 300000 for example to lower the bill.
pawelMethodReplies.implication: 未打满。是消耗周额度的百分之几、看每 1% 跳动后外推到「整周可用」，再合成「一个月的 allowance」。不是整月打满面板。

pawelMethodReplies.text: It does. I didn't want to purchase it just for this experiment. Also, my primary Claude subscription is $200/mo. Used another one, $100/mo, that wasn't busy.
pawelMethodReplies.implication: Claude Max $100 行来自另一只不忙的 $100 账户，不是他主用的 $200 订阅。

pawelMethodReplies.text: Neither: Google's standard paid rate, $3 in / $15 out per MTok. It listed no promo when I measured (Nov 18). If the API price changes, the multiplier changes with it. The cost of a run on the subscription doesn't: it's the share of the plan the run uses up (1.8% of $99.99 ≈
pawelMethodReplies.implication: Neon 按标准价 $3/$15 计（无促销）。$99.99 是他用的套餐价。回复在 1.8% of $99.99 处截断。倍率随 API 标价变动。
